limits_and_scope: EMFILE is deliberately applied to the real Task child with RLIMIT_NOFILE32; it does not claim exhaustion of the main App Node process.
EAGAIN is reached in the owned container pids64 cgroup with at most64 sequential bounded child spawn attempts, followed by termination and wait of only the created children.
Native ENOSPC is limited to own32MiB/64MiB tmpfs mounts; ordinary TMPDIR keeps the product 2GiB admission budget.
Read-only DataRoot admission rejects and preserves the complete parent domains; a separate --read-only container rootfs test records actual Task EROFS with writable owned data and scratch volumes.
The receive timeout uses an owned loopback peer accepting but never replying. Offline Git is a real Git command executed as a Task; it does not assert public Git URL validation coverage.

Runtime interruption is actual official24.22.3 partial archive transfer followed by Docker bridge disconnect only for this owned container, terminal failure/nonREADY, bridge reconnect and actual repair to READY.
Real project-quota EDQUOT is separately qualified by parent case S5-LINUX-REAL-PROJECT-QUOTA-EDQUOT in a dedicated NativeARM VM; this package does not claim App Task/backup EDQUOT.
No earlier candidate or first private-driver attempt is counted as a final PASS. The stable-driver final complete8+11 rerun is the qualification result.

evidence_count_policy: Per-group actual runner cases only; receipt/checkpoint rows and earlier attempts are not summed as unique PASS; source regressions are not mislabeled compiled release tests

limitations: Browser matrix target is actual Linux ARM64 engines Chromium159.0.8154.6/Firefox159.0/WebKit27.2; this does not claim native Safari or Windows coverage.
Each engine includes six compiled application flows and one independent wrong-service protocol negative; local Git fixture DI does not qualify public remote URL policy.
Portable UI proves preview/staging. Independent backend restart/restore is separately exercised by the Node backup case.

Darwin is a hash-sealed private owned release with readonly compiled/helper/entry subtrees; root and dependency directories were not claimed OS immutable. Linux product permissions/PID1 entry are separately qualified by parent.

Finite workload has no defined latency SLO. Empirical p50/p95 retain actual sample counts; p99 is null. External peaks sampled at400ms include fixture/cleanup, while formal RSS50ms samples cover workload.
WAL files were not observed during samples; WAL peak remains null with reason. Persistent DB timing uses wall clock millisecond strings and eight samples, not monotonic precision.
All earlier candidate outcomes and original WebKit failures remain separate history; none are inherited as RC10 test passes.

active_context_shutdown_unresolved.cause: UNKNOWN; successful context-drained cases and one active-context non-reproduction do not resolve the original failure

scope_limits: The UI path actually stages an encrypted imported archive and the production CLI automatically closes and re-launches the App in the same OS PID to durable COMPLETE.

A new independent CLI OS PID is started after COMPLETE; the same browser process uses a new context to log in and verify persisted COMPLETE, source, Task, original Run/Attempt/logs and a new UI Task execution.
The controlled browser context is explicitly closed before each normal SIGTERM shutdown. The earlier active-context30s stop failure remains unresolved and is not replaced by these PASS results.
The sole later causal observation exited naturally while the browser context was still open; this is non-reproduction, not an application fix.
The original three engines seven-case suites retain their prior portable-preview/PENDING scope and are not rewritten.
This target is actual Linux ARM64 Chromium/Firefox/WebKit with applicationNode22.23.5, not nativeSafari/Windows coverage.

constraints.raw_evidence_collectors: Only readonly volume readers use UID0 with DAC_OVERRIDE; production App always remains UID10001.

limits_and_scope: EMFILE is deliberately applied to the real Task child with RLIMIT_NOFILE32; it does not claim exhaustion of the main App Node process.
EAGAIN is reached in the owned container pids64 cgroup with at most64 sequential bounded child spawn attempts, followed by termination and wait of only the created children.
Native ENOSPC is limited to own32MiB/64MiB tmpfs mounts; ordinary TMPDIR keeps the product 2GiB admission budget.
Read-only DataRoot admission rejects and preserves the complete parent domains; a separate --read-only container rootfs test records actual Task EROFS with writable owned data and scratch volumes.
The receive timeout uses an owned loopback peer accepting but never replying. Offline Git is a real Git command executed as a Task; it does not assert public Git URL validation coverage.

Runtime interruption is actual official24.22.3 partial archive transfer followed by Docker bridge disconnect only for this owned container, terminal failure/nonREADY, bridge reconnect and actual repair to READY.
Real project-quota EDQUOT is separately qualified by parent case S5-LINUX-REAL-PROJECT-QUOTA-EDQUOT in a dedicated NativeARM VM; this package does not claim App Task/backup EDQUOT.
No earlier candidate or first private-driver attempt is counted as a final PASS. The stable-driver final complete8+11 rerun is the qualification result.

platform.contract_interpretation: Existing active runner shutdown cancellation predates S5 and active CANCELLED is a legal transition; S0 does not explicitly settle whether normal SIGTERM should constitute cancellation intent. The frozen testcase accepts active submission states but does not accept resulting CANCELLED. This unresolved contract/precondition mismatch does not authorize current assertion relaxation or PASS.

normal_shutdown_flow: V2Application.close pauses producers then closes HTTP/notification/runtime/services
TaskExecutionService.close calls active runner.cancel and awaits done
WorkspaceAttemptRunner coordinates lifecycle cancellation and reverse cleanup; successful cleanup permits persisted CANCELLED

frozen_contract_evidence.meaning: Active cancel intent is coordinated with child supervision and Config/Node cleanup; no early FD clearing.
INTERRUPTED belongs to safe dead-owner/active-ghost recovery; a normally coordinated shutdown is not automatically this case.
RESOLVING can terminal CANCELLED on cancellation facts.
RUNNING can terminal CANCELLED after child exit and successful cleanup.
Terminal states are not automatically returned to QUEUED.

conclusions: The active cancellation close path is byte-identical from S2 through S4 and RC10; this evidence does not show a new S5 behavior regression.
Legal CANCELLED state alone does not settle whether normal SIGTERM should be treated as cancellation intent. Frozen S0 does not explicitly define this mapping.
The actual run was already started with attempt1, so it cannot be claimed as a proven still-QUEUED persistence scenario.
Current required S4 full-group regression remains failed. Two57/58 runs cannot be combined into58/58.

Next candidate should make normal shutdown policy explicit and split deterministic still-QUEUED preservation from active coordinated-stop/cancellation and dead-owner SIGKILL recovery tests; no current assertion widening is performed.
